dict.string: JARVIS needs microphone access for push-to-talk and always-on wake word listening
JARVIS uses System Events to show notifications and toggle dark mode.
JARVIS reads the Obsidian vault you connect, if it is in your Desktop folder. It only reads notes and never changes them.
JARVIS reads the Obsidian vault you connect, if it is in your Documents folder. It only reads notes and never changes them.
